w_plain: Write the clearest possible version for a second-language scroller. Prefer the simplest common word every time.
w_hook: Write the version with the strongest first 3 seconds and one clean payoff, then one invitation.
w_faith: Write the version a careful Bible reader would sign off on claim by claim, still short and plain.
w_story: Write the version that puts the listener at the foot of the cross, concrete and visual, one scene at a time (pictures change every 4 seconds).
w_free: Write the best version you can by your own judgment.
